BiblicalUsage: Once, in the priests who came back to Jerusalem: his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer. The name is a priest counted among the chiefs of the fathers, and the count is all the Bible says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A name in a list of returning priests carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the rebuilding, that the priests came back by their fathers' houses and were counted two hundred and forty-two strong.
